Independent serial PhysCal callback references for issue #175

Reproduce from repository root:
JULIA_NUM_THREADS=1 JULIA_MVMC_MPI=0 julia +1.13.1 --project=extern/Julia-mVMC scripts/generate_physcal_callbacks_175.jl

Julia 1.13.1 and Manifest-v1.13.toml are required. Per-workload provenance
records reference/script/manifest/input hashes, architecture, Julia commit
and actual BLAS version/threads. Normal Rust tests only read these files;
they never invoke C/Julia or derive expectations from Rust sampler replay.

Inputs and zqp originate in the historical native-C-derived HubbardChain
and SpinChain Lanczos fixtures under extern/Julia-mVMC/test/integration/reference.
Their metadata identifies C revision 622166afe33c6be3402d7c926db7e9c0003a47c4.
The original 1000 saved configurations, warm-up, interval, fixed records and
seed 1 are retained. Only NLanczosMode (1 or 2), NDataQtySmp (2) and
NDataIdxStart (7) change. Hubbard covers hopping/intra-site Coulomb; spin
covers exchange/spin-diagonal interactions. No InterAll/RBM/OptTrans extension.

These NEW records are independently generated Julia actual callbacks and
trajectories following the C numerical/input contract, NOT new native-C
executable runs or C-confirmed full trajectories. Native macOS verification
is not claimed. Copied inputs retain their upstream GPL-3.0 provenance;
see extern/mVMC-1.3.0/COPYING and extern/Julia-mVMC/LICENSE. No upstream
source is modified.

C Hamiltonian basis has NLSHam=2, {I,H}, in include/global.h:303. Modes 1/2
use this supported basis, mode 2 additionally accumulating corrected Green
arrays; no configurable matrix-size extension is introduced. C VMCPhysCal
orders sampling, main calculation, averaging, counter reduction and output
(vmcmain.c:531 onward). Julia then invokes the actual callback with indexes
0/1 and status 0. These are recorded Julia arguments, not invented C callbacks.

Snapshots only observe; primitive SFMT wrappers delegate unchanged calls
and conversions. next624 is a non-consuming SFMT peek, draw-count cumulative
UInt32 words since seed 1. initialized is after the single InitParameter,
before fixed restoration. sample-i is before measurement. averaged-i is
after averaging/counter reduction/output. callback-i observes actual callback.
Complex files store real/imaginary pairs, not bitwise computed-float contracts.
RNG words, configurations, indexes, statuses and defined flags remain exact.

fixed-parameters.txt comes from independent Julia fixed loading and C-order
sync; consumed-count.txt records consumed slots. C-defined optimization flag
writes are independently enumerated from real Gutzwiller/Jastrow/Orbital
definitions in parameter order; optimization-flags-written.txt masks imaginary
cells native C GetInfoOpt leaves unwritten. No allocation values are invented.
